safe_test_strategy: Compare read-only API operations under explicitly different permissions.
expected_behavior: API operations must enforce the configured permission contract.

potential_false_positives.scenario: Public, cached, reflected or synthetic content resembles a protected result.
potential_false_positives.mitigation: Verify the resource policy, distinct identities, provenance and negative controls before confirming.

confirmation_criteria: Protected API data disclosed to an identity without the required permission.
